title: Physiology, Lifecycle and Environmental Tolerance
objective: Separate descriptive biology from executable respiration, sustenance, rest, aging/lifecycle and temperature/pressure/gravity/radiation/water/vacuum or other environmental tolerance hooks so environment resolution consumes typed capabilities rather than prose biology.
acceptance: descriptive fields cannot silently mutate mechanics
boundaries: MVPS-05 owns species-facing physiology/lifecycle/environment-tolerance integration contracts only.
Descriptive biology remains non-executable under MVPS-01.
Movement/sense capability integration remains MVPS-04 and is consumed by reference.
Executable grants outside environmental/physiology scope remain MVPS-06/shared-owner territory.
MVPS-06+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
next_action: Establish causal RED proving descriptive biology cannot execute mechanics, executable respiration/sustenance/rest/lifecycle/environmental tolerances are typed shared-owner references with provenance, and environment evaluation consumes capability/tolerance refs rather than prose or species-name branching; then implement only MVPS-05 contracts/fixtures.
